gallery.title: File:Vorce Station, Burnaby, BC 01.jpg
gallery.description: Vorce Station. The station, in the heart of the Burnaby Village, was used as a band stand during the commemoration of Canada and the 40 th anniversary of the Burnaby Village Museum. A latin band - waiting for the tram. Built in 1911 for the b.c. electric railway company’s Burnaby Lake interurban line
